messages:
Asha Raman: Kickoff for PartnerNova listing across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need artifact policy, SBOM, image signing, and a single trial SKU mapping. Who volunteers to draft the runbook?
Marco Diaz: I can draft the runbook + TF snippets. Quick questions: Partner will provide AMI for AWS and container images for GCP/Azure, right?
Asha Raman: Correct. AMI + container. Trial = 14 days, meter = partnernova-seat.
Riley Nguyen: Security checklist: CycloneDX SBOM, cosign signatures, vulnerability scan report (trivy), and explicit KMS ownership note. If model weights are bundled, include license provenance.
Marco Diaz: Runbook outline: 1) Artifact hosting requirements (signed SBOM, public read link or presigned URL), 2) Ingestion steps per cloud, 3) TF module variables and sample .tfvars, 4) verification commands.
sec-bot: Created artifact-checklist: https://rwd/internal/marketplace/artifacts/1815000000 :white_check_mark:
Marco Diaz: GCP sample manifest (snippet): `{"name":"partnernova-container","sku":"partnernova-seat-trial","trial_days":14}`
Marco Diaz: AWS AMI metadata example: `{"ami_name":"partnernova-2026-03","sbom":"s3://partnernova-artifacts/sboms/pn-2026.cdx.json","signed_by":"partnernova-cosign"}`
Riley Nguyen: Add policy: presigned URLs must expire <=72h and SBOM must be CycloneDX 1.4 JSON with components/licenses/hashes.
Asha Raman: Timeline: need signed DPA + redlined EULA and artifact proofs before marketplace submission. Target submit = next Wednesday.
Marco Diaz: I'll open a PR with TF module changes and runbook draft by EOD tomorrow and tag @devex and @ops for review.
Asha Raman: Please also request PartnerNova region list and support contacts. We'll need support SLA for first 30 days.
Marco Diaz: Noted. Will post PR link here when ready.
Riley Nguyen: I'll prepare a minimal verification script (cosign verify, trivy scan, SBOM schema check) to run in the ingestion pipeline.
Asha Raman: Thanks team — short sync tomorrow 9am PT to review. :rocket:
